title: Fail-closed precise OpenAPI legacy registry transition

phases.objective: Allow the exact historical completion-certification root operation to transition from inline OpenAPI to its reviewed registered path-item reference, while keeping malformed identities, security profiles, source metadata, unrelated paths, and alternate references fail-closed.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: openapi-precise-contract-registry-sync.mjs --write against a temporary copy of the repository root OpenAPI, registry, and Support Ticket route source
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact historical inline operation is replaced by `./openapi/support-ticket-runtime-completion.yaml#/certifyAdminSupportTicketExternalDeliveryCompletion`, check mode is idempotent, and all non-exact variants remain blocked without mutation.
steps: Copy the current repository root OpenAPI document, precise route registry, and Support Ticket runtime route source into an isolated temporary repository.

Read back the historical operation and require operationId `issueSupportTicketExternalDeliveryCompletionCertification`, its detailed request body, success response, admin security alternatives, and consequential classification.
Require the exact registered signature and exact reviewed path-item reference.
Run the real precise registry synchronizer in write mode and require the root path to become the exact registered `$ref`.
Run check mode against the written copy and require zero conflicts and zero further generated drift.
Run malformed identity, reduced security, conflicting source metadata, alternate `$ref`, and unrelated-path cases and require fail-closed rejection without rewriting the root document.
assertions: The historical root operationId is exactly `issueSupportTicketExternalDeliveryCompletionCertification`.
The operation remains consequential and requires the exact admin bearer/backend API key security alternatives before transition.
Successful composition produces the exact registered `$ref`, zero conflicts, and an idempotent follow-up check.
Wrong operation identity, reduced security, conflicting source metadata, alternate path-item reference, and unrelated paths remain `registered_path_inline_contract_not_replaceable`.
No SQL, migration authorization or Apply, registry activation sync, provider call, credential access, deployment, restart, Production ref mutation, or external send occurs.

phases.objective: Run Protected Promotion Generated Artifact Refresh on a non-merge Production comparison and commit the exact generated root OpenAPI reference through the governed generated-artifact path.
Keep all non-allowlisted registered inline contracts and alternate registered references fail-closed.
Rebuild and validate a fresh exact-main-tree Production candidate after the generated contract is merged.
Promote only an explicitly authorized exact candidate after cumulative OpenAPI generation and E2E checks pass.
